title: If I Had to Sell My Home in 2026… I’d Follow THESE 7 Steps (Even in a Brutal Market)
description:
Selling a home in Central Texas right now feels almost impossible, right?

If I had to sell my own house in this wild 2025 market, this is exactly how I’d do it—step by step—to sell fast, protect my equity, and stay sane.

In this video, I’ll walk you through:

How to benchmark your home on Zillow (and what not to copy)

The one inspection move that flips negotiations in your favor

The exact data I’d want in hand before choosing a price

Why I’d pack up 90% of my stuff before we ever hit the market

How to use the “slow season” to your advantage instead of getting punished by it

I’m Stephen Harris, a Central Texas real estate broker and data nerd who closes 50+ homes a year. I made this video so you don’t lose money—or your mind—trying to sell in this market. We serve Killeen, Harker Heights, Temple, Belton, Copperas Cove, Georgetown, Pflugerville & Hutto
